adjudication.h1_rationale: Fresh-C adds substantive partial prior art for generic gap-dependent plasmonic coupling and morphology–SERS relationships, but none directly demonstrates a reproducible directional response to controlled polymer-defined inner/outer gaps in the specified Ag-bridge architecture. The corpus therefore preserves the frozen bounded-extension status without upgrading or rewriting it.
adjudication.h3_rationale: Fresh-C provides substantive positive evidence that measurement configuration, drying-related deposition, analyte localization, hotspot organization, and substrate context can alter SERS intensity, reproducibility, and spectral appearance. In particular, reserve #14 reports configuration-dependent reproducibility and visible solution-versus-deposited spectral differences, while reserves #2 and #10 report related context-dependent spectral or intensity effects. These studies do not establish the exact paired solution-to-dried transition for the same analyte-mixed Ag-shell core-satellite preparation, so the relational-gap candidate is weakened but not eliminated. For repaired reserve #14, the positive reported evidence supports erosion; its remaining limitations are not used to support preservation or completeness.

supporting_evidence.scientific_role: Supports the generic directional dependence of Ag plasmonic coupling and near-field enhancement on interparticle spacing, while not testing the polymer-separated Ag-bridge architecture.
Supports a structural-dimension–SERS intensity relationship through cavity-size variation, but not the frozen polymer-defined inner/outer gap.
Supports controlled Ag-shell growth associated with directional SERS enhancement, while using a different architecture and parameter.
Supports the general nanogap-coupling mechanism and gap-related SERS response in Au monolayers, not the specified Ag-bridge architecture.

Provides positive evidence for configuration-dependent SERS reproducibility and spectral differences between solution Raman and deposited nanoparticle-array measurements; because the reserve is repaired, this positive evidence supports erosion, while its missing exact paired comparison is not used to support preservation.
Supports context-dependent differences between solution fluorescence/Raman and analyte adsorbed on Ag colloids, including altered spectral appearance and signal variability.
Reports drying-related pre-concentration, coffee-ring deposition, and intensity/distribution effects in SERS biofluid workflows, providing substantive related context evidence.
